items.title: 13.4 Oxidising agents ke taur par halogens ki nisbati reactivity (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 13.4 with Table 13.4, printed pages 294-295.

blocks.text: Sab azad halogens metals aur zyada tar non-metals se react karte waqt oxidising agents ka kaam karte hain; metals ke saath ionic compounds banate hue halogens electrons le kar manfi halide ions bante hain: 2Na(s) + Cl2(g) se 2NaCl(s). Oxidising taqat group mein neeche ghat-ti hai, fluorine sab se zyada aur iodine sab se kam: F2 > Cl2 > Br2 > I2. Halogens ki reactivity seedhi un ki electron lene aur halide ions banane ki salahiyat se juri hai. Fluorine electron lene ka sab se zyada rujhan rakhti hai, aur woh doosre sab halide ions ko un ke solutions se oxidise aur be-dakhal karti hai: F2 + 2Cl- se 2F- + Cl2, F2 + 2Br- se 2F- + Br2, F2 + 2I- se 2F- + I2. Isi tarah chlorine Br- aur I- ko be-dakhal karti hai, bromine I- ko, aur iodine kisi halide ion ko oxidise nahi kar sakti.

Oxidising taqat ko standard electrode potentials E standard (X2/X-) se jora ja sakta hai, jo fluorine se iodine tak kam musbat hote jate hain (Table 13.4), ghat-ti oxidising taqat zahir karte hue; fluorine sab se reactive halogen aur sab se taqatwar oxidising agent hai. Oxidising taqat dissociation ki energy, atoms ki electron affinity, ions ki hydration energies, aur Br2 aur I2 ke liye vaporisation ki garmi par munhasir hai: kam dissociation energy, zyada electron affinity aur apne ion ki zyada hydration energy wala halogen zyada oxidising taqat rakhta hai.

blocks.prompt: Kya aabi NaCl aur F2 ke darmiyan reaction mumkin hai? Muadla likhein, aur oxidising taqat aur standard reduction potential ka taalluq batayein (Quick Check 13.2b, c).
blocks.explanation: Haan: fluorine chlorine se taqatwar oxidising agent hai (E standard +2.87 V ke muqable +1.36 V), to woh chloride ions ko oxidise aur chlorine ko be-dakhal karti hai: F2(g) + 2NaCl(aq) se 2NaF(aq) + Cl2(g) (fluorine pani se bhi react karti hai). X2/X- ka standard reduction potential jitna zyada musbat, X2 utni aasani se electrons leta hai aur oxidising agent ke taur par utna taqatwar hai.

items: Halogens electrons le kar oxidise karte hain (2Na + Cl2 se 2NaCl); oxidising taqat F2 > Cl2 > Br2 > I2, E standard +2.87, +1.36, +1.07, +0.54 V ke mutabiq; har halogen apne neeche ke halides ko be-dakhal karta hai (Cl2 + 2Br- se 2Cl- + Br2).
Oxidising taqat kam dissociation energy, zyada electron affinity, X- ki zyada hydration energy (aur Br2, I2 ke liye kam vaporisation garmi) se barhti hai.
